errors.evidence: The figure shows grouped bar charts, not stacked bar charts. The bars for 'Bund', 'Länder', and 'Gemeinden' are placed side-by-side for each year, not stacked on top of each other.

The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the left chart represents 'Bruttoanlageinvestitionen' (gross fixed capital formation) and the right chart represents 'Nettoanlageinvestitionen' (net fixed capital formation) as a percentage of GDP.

The reference description mentions a high share of investments in the early 1990s (over 3% of GDP) and a decline to around 2.5% by 2000 in the left chart, which is not explicitly highlighted in the machine-generated description.

The reference description notes that net investments in the right chart fall into the negative range and later fluctuate between 0 and 0.5%, which is not explicitly summarized in the machine-generated description.
The reference description states the highest value in 1992 is over 3%, but the figure shows it closer to 3.1%, not 3.2%.
The figure shows the lowest negative value for 'Gemeinden' closer to -0.2%, not -0.3%.
The reference description mentions that the net investments in the right chart never exceed 0.6% after 1995, which is not explicitly stated in the machine-generated description.
